recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Do not add redundant core status prose or edit inactive moved resource sources for this historical seed. Any future DeviceUsage or SupplyDelivery status changes should be handled in the OO Incubator source/publication path.
issue_request: FHIR-10300 was a Published/Persuasive Orders and Observations change request for DSTU2 asking to align event-resource status terminology for DeviceUseStatement, Supply, Observation, and DiagnosticReport with the Event pattern. Jira comments added entered-in-error/cancelled to the framing, recorded Observation and DiagnosticReport status alignment as completed, and left SupplyDelivery and DeviceUseStatement as follow-up work.
initial_application: Historical commits applied the issue family: 0fddebbe824485506904fadc81eff5f749e8356f explicitly says it is also part of #10300 and updated Observation/DiagnosticReport status spreadsheets and mappings; 5a6e321c64ad0c1df8f1b8a956ecffdcae9748e5 included #10300 in Event-pattern SupplyDelivery work; and 1639b8d104fc8901a5f6576bcb044981c1320bc4 later updated OO event resources under FHIR-10299, including DeviceUseStatement status/mapping work.
additional_context: FHIR-10436 confirms Observation and DiagnosticReport status value sets were intentionally kept distinct while aligned. FHIR-10299 is the broader OO Event-pattern tracker. Current source/fhir.ini keeps DiagnosticReport and Observation active/approved but has no active DeviceUsage, SupplyDelivery, or SupplyRequest resource entries, retaining only DeviceUseStatement=@DeviceUsage as a historical alias. Commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed DeviceUsage/SupplyDelivery from active core build configuration and rewired module links to OO Incubator. Related combined-branch audits for FHIR-12711 and FHIR-14142 already record the external ownership boundary.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Observation.status and DiagnosticReport.status remain required code elements with required bindings, entered-in-error and unknown support, and the domain-specific aligned codes approved in the issue family. Editing inactive source/deviceusage or source/supplydelivery files would not change the current core build.
